title: AgentOffer OfferProvider Response Schema v1.0
description: Adopted Partner supply success payload or channel error envelope. AON resolves Partner source identities and creates the public Query response separately.

successEnvelope.description: Partner-authored supply response for one AON OfferProvider request.

request_id.description: Exact request_id from the OfferProvider request.

protocol_version.description: Transport protocol line selected for this Partner response.

language.description: Language of Partner-authored user-facing response content under the stable-v1.0 language profile.

offers.description: Partner supply Offers. Each uses source_offer_id and never contains AON offer_id, offer_instance_id, or match_reason.

code.description: Stable machine-readable Partner channel error class.

message.description: Human-readable error summary intended for integration diagnostics.

data.description: Reserved empty data object for the v1.0 Partner error envelope.

extra.description: Optional deployment-specific diagnostic metadata; it must not redefine code semantics.
